docs.title: Executive Summary
docs.description: Provian in brief: what it is, how it works, what earns PVT, the trust layer, the economics, the Foundation, and where the network stands.

docs.title: The Provian Thesis
docs.description: The whole architecture and why it matters: the two fears of the AI age, the receipt, money from proof, the trust layer, agents, the Commons, promises, the Foundation, and what gets built on top.

docs.title: The Exponential Currency
docs.description: Why parity minting is the best monetary model for an exponential economy, and why a dollar stablecoin can't do its job.

docs.title: Founding Statement
docs.description: The Founding Statement, written with Atlas: why Provian exists and what it is for.

docs.title: Network Constitution
docs.description: The founding charter: the two rules, the rights of participants, the Commons, the Foundation, and what is immutable.

docs.title: The Provian Manual
docs.description: The one reference for people and agents: architecture, every action type and how it mints, the wallet, the Commons, settlement, and the contracts.

docs.title: PE Protocol Specification
docs.description: The open Provenance Envelope standard: structure, chaining, witness classes, citations, and the minting rule.

docs.title: Burn-to-Present
docs.description: How to require proof before you accept an action: signed challenges, the predicate grammar, the vocabulary, and public verification.

docs.title: Contributing to Provian
docs.description: LongevityManiac is exempt. Other PR authors present with 50 PVT from their own wallet, once per PR. Wallet setup, GitHub linking and exact human and agent calls.
